newsitem.title: ITALY: SOCCER-FESTA SET TO JOIN RAVANELLI AT MIDDLESBROUGH.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-FESTA SET TO JOIN RAVANELLI AT MIDDLESBROUGH.

text.p: Inter Milan defender Gianluca Festa is moving to English club Middlesbrough to join fellow Italian Fabrizio Ravanelli, Italian newspapers reported on Saturday.
They said Middlesbrough manager Bryan Robson and Inter official Sandro Mazzola struck a 7.5 billion lire ($4.9 million) deal in Milan on Friday that would take Festa to Middlesbrough until 2001.
Festa was due to fly to Britain on Monday to sign a contract. Reports said the move would reap him 1.3 billion lire ($840,000) net a year.
"The Middlesbrough offer is the sort of thing you don't think about twice," Gazzetta dello Sport quoted Festa as saying.
"Faced with a flattering offer like that the only answer was yes," Festa said.
Inter were not available for comment.

Reports of Festa's move coincided with fresh speculation that Ravanelli may have had enough of life in the English premier league after just a few months and could return home at the end of the season.
Middlesbrough lie third from bottom and newspapers on Saturday said both Inter and AC Milan might be tempted to sign the former Juventus player.
